title: Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org
author: Greg Mohler
description: Put native GitHub features to work to review outside collaborator access and archive stale repositories. The post Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Working with outside collaborators can add more work for a repository owner. You need to confirm who still needs access, change permissions as projects evolve, and archive repositories once they’ve served their purpose.
takeaways: We faced this problem in a shared organization where GitHub employees (“Hubbers”) collaborate with customers and partners on product trials and professional services engagements.
Meet Evergreen Evergreen is a GitHub App that automates organization hygiene through two workflows: Outside collaborator access reviews.
Our answer was Evergreen , a GitHub App built with native GitHub features.
